display.purpose: Section h2s. Sora 700-800 with -0.02em to -0.03em tracking. The studio's hard structural voice.

hero.purpose: The h1 in the dark hero band. Maximum scale. white-space nowrap at desktop.

title.purpose: Card titles, panel headings, modal titles.

body.purpose: Hero lead, section intros, primary reading copy. line-height 1.6.

eyebrow.purpose: The signature named kicker. 13px, 0.04em tracking, green-deep, with 20x2px green bar prefix. Once or twice per page.

caption.purpose: Rating helper text, floating-badge subline, metadata. 11-12.5px, faint color.

shadows.name: card-resting
shadows.purpose: Default card lift on hover on the mint surface.

shadows.name: card-high-lift
shadows.purpose: Expanded work-gallery panel; the promoted-dominant card.

shadows.name: phone-deep
shadows.purpose: Hero phone mockups against the dark surface; two-layer for legibility.

shadows.name: floating-badge
shadows.purpose: Hero floating badges, registering against the dark band.

shadows.name: green-bloom
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA signature glow; shadow inherits the button color.

shadows.name: studio-card
shadows.purpose: Stat grid lift on the mint surface.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Primary lift transitions: buttons, cards, hover blooms. 250-400ms.

motion.name: ease-layout
motion.purpose: Large layout transitions: work-gallery flex expansion, orbital node rotation. 600-700ms.

motion.name: ease-counter
motion.purpose: Stat counter count-up over 1700ms. Implemented in JS via easeOut(t) = 1 - (1-t)^3.

motion.name: floaty
motion.purpose: Hero floating badge vertical bob. Each badge has a distinct delay (0.2s, 1.1s, 0.6s) so they bob independently.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The signature green CTA. Pill shape, green bloom shadow, lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; padding: 13px 26px; background: #4cc46a; color: #06210f; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -10px #4cc46a; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1), background 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6bdd86; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -10px #4cc46a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -10px #4cc46a, 0 0 0 4px rgba(76,196,106,0.35); }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: The secondary ink button. Used where the green would compete with a green surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; padding: 13px 26px; background: #14181a; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1), background 0.25s; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #000000; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(20,24,26,0.25); }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: The signature named kicker. Used once or twice per page, never as section grammar.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #2c9a4c; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 20px; height: 2px; background: #4cc46a; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: White card on the mint surface. Lift on hover; border fades to transparent.
components.html:
Product Design

Research-led UX and pixel-perfect UI that make complex products feel effortless. We design systems, not just screens.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e9ede9; border-radius: 18px; padding: 26px 24px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -24px rgba(20,24,26,0.22); border-color: transparent; } .ds-card-tile { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 18px; background: #c8b6f6; color: #5b3fa8; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #14181a; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: #5d666b; margin: 0; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Cream-on-white pill label. Used in the service-explorer chips and the work-gallery tags (which use a transparent variant on dark).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1; color: #14181a; background: #f5f8f5; border: 1px solid #e9ede9; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Dark-band nav link. Muted at rest, white when active or hovered.
components.html: ServicesWorkProcess
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 34px; background: #0c0e0d; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #aeb4af; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #4cc46a; }

narrative.overview:
Zenvego reads like walking into a real working studio: confident on the surface, busy underneath, quiet over the top. The page does not pose for the camera. There's no stage set, no lobby art, no marketing veneer; what's pinned to the wall is the actual work, and what's said is what the studio actually does. A founder closing the tab should think 'those people know what they're doing,' not 'wow, what a site.'

The system is anchored by two surfaces and one voice. A near-black dark band carries the nav, hero, and footer. A mint wash with a faint emerald 48px grid carries everything else, unbroken across section seams. The brand speaks in mint and green; the other accents are reserved for illustration and never carry primary UI.

This system explicitly rejects the generic agency template, the overdesigned portfolio, the crypto/AI hype aesthetic, and the stuffy corporate consultancy.
keyCharacteristics: One color voice: green. Other hues are illustration only, never primary UI.
Two structural surfaces: dark band (nav + hero + footer) and mint page wash everywhere else.
Type does most of the work. Sora at 800 with -0.03em tracking carries hero hierarchy; the body holds at Manrope 400.
Motion is tactile, not decorative: lift-on-hover, conic light sweeps, fanned phone floats. Every animation has a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
A faint emerald 48px grid runs the full page so section seams never crack the surface.
Eyebrows are a deliberate, named brand pattern: not section grammar, not on every block.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green is the only brand color. Mint, cream, ink, white, and the dark band are structural; green is the only color that carries identity. The four illustration accents (orange/teal/purple/blue/pink) are reserved for per-service distinction and decorative imagery. They are never used for primary buttons, primary links, hover states, or text-as-emphasis.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on one of exactly two backgrounds: the dark brand surface (#0c0e0d) or the mint page wash (#e9f3ec). Cards on top of the mint wash use white; cards on top of the dark surface use rgba(255,255,255,0.06). New surfaces don't introduce new background hues.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Green Rule
rules.body: Any green surface that holds text uses #06210f for the text, not white. White on #4cc46a measures only 2.7:1 (fails AA); #06210f clears 7.4:1.

rules.name: The Type-First Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by type, not by color or decoration. A heading is bigger and a different family from body copy; a label is uppercase and tracked; a caption is smaller and faint. Color is for surfaces; weight and size are for hierarchy.

rules.name: The -0.03em Floor
rules.body: Hero and display headings track at -0.02em to -0.03em. Never tighter than -0.04em (letters touch). The Sora 800 weight at large sizes carries the design; loosen tracking and the headline reads as a default browser h1.

rules.name: The Named-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The eyebrow is part of the brand voice; it's named (The Studio, Our Work, How we work). It is NOT scaffolding above every section. Use it once or twice per page, where the label itself is a brand artifact. Never use 01 / 02 / 03 numbered eyebrows; numbers only earn their place inside a real sequence.

rules.name: The Direction-Down Rule
rules.body: All resting shadows offset downward only. No 0 -... ambient glows on cards. Light comes from above; the studio shouldn't feel like a stage.

rules.name: The Color-Inherit Rule
rules.body: When a CTA is colored (the green button, the bottom-row wmetric pill on work cards), the shadow inherits the surface color at low opacity. The lift reads as light spilling from the button itself, not as a separate effect bolted on.

rules.name: The Hover-Lifts-2px Rule
rules.body: Cards translate up exactly 6px on hover; buttons translate 2-3px. Larger displacements break the surface metaphor.

dos: Do keep green as the only voice. Buttons, links, active states, hover blooms, eyebrow labels: green or its ramp. Orange/teal/purple/blue/pink are illustration only.
Do sit every section on one of two surfaces: the dark band (#0c0e0d) or the mint page wash (#e9f3ec). White cards lift off the mint wash; tonal-overlay cards lift off the dark band.
Do use #06210f for text on any green surface. White on green here measures 2.7:1 and fails contrast.
Do carry the 48px emerald grid through every light section. Section seams don't crack; the grid runs unbroken from the announcement bar to the footer.
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1-h3 and verify the hero copy fits at the mobile breakpoint.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce alternative.
Do use the eyebrow as a named brand artifact ('The Studio', 'Our Work', 'How we work'). One or two per page.
Do ship at least one concrete proof per section: a real screenshot, a number, a named project.
donts: Don't introduce a new brand color. The system speaks in green. New accents are not a design solution; they're a reflex.
Don't apply the eyebrow above every section. The kicker-eyebrow on every block is the saturated AI scaffolding pattern.
Don't apply 01 / 02 / 03 numbered eyebrows. Numbers only earn their place inside a real ordered sequence.
Don't use white text on green. Use #06210f.
Don't use --body (#5d666b) on a dark background, or --faint-d (#8a938d) for body copy on any surface.
Don't use side-stripe borders as a default callout pattern.
Don't use glassmorphism / backdrop-blur as decoration.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient background).
Don't ship the generic agency template (big stock hero video, row of stock client logos, identical icon-heading-paragraph card trio).
Don't ship the overdesigned-portfolio cliche (cursor effects, WebGL backgrounds, scroll-juggle for its own sake).
Don't ship the crypto/AI hype aesthetic (gradient-on-gradient, glow text, dark-mode-as-vibe).
Don't drop below 4.5:1 for body text.
